plain_english: Having examined own self, examining again the hymned conduct, the worshipper sets it forth in hymn amid difference-held-as-one. The examined self, at every moment of object-knowing: thus in Your hymn I stand here always — effortless.
sanskrit_cite: vimṛśya svātmānaṃ vimṛśati punaḥ stutyacaritaṃ | nikhilaviṣayajñānasamaye taditthaṃ tvatstotre 'ham iha satataṃ yatnarahitaḥ
